info.title: viz ruler API
info.description: Two faces over a tenant's rules and alerts. `/api/v1/rules` and `/api/v1/alerts` return Prometheus' own response shapes, read-only. `/api/v1/monitors/...` is viz's API. The tenant is always the one the API key belongs to; no path, query, header or body field selects it. Every write accepts `dryRun` (query parameter, or a `dryRun: true` body field): it validates and reports what would happen and changes nothing.

get.summary: Rule groups with health and active alerts, in Prometheus' /api/v1/rules shape

parameters.name: file[]
parameters.description: viz reports a group's file as `shard-<n>`

parameters.name: match[]
parameters.description: Not supported: answered with 400 bad_data rather than ignored.

get.summary: Active (pending and firing) alerts, in Prometheus' /api/v1/alerts shape
List monitors with the fields the Monitors screen shows

post.summary: Create a monitor: one alerting rule plus its presentation

200.description: Dry run: what would be created; nothing was saved

get.summary: Rule groups as rule-file JSON, with the shard that holds each

put.summary: Create or replace a rule group; alert state follows rules whose name, expression and labels are unchanged

delete.summary: Delete a rule group; its firing alerts are resolved

get.summary: Export every group as a Prometheus rule file (YAML)

200.description: Rule file. With extensions=false viz's own fields are left out and listed in a leading comment.

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.description: Keep viz's fields (no_data*, monitor). Default true.

post.summary: Import a Prometheus rule file (YAML, or the same document as JSON); groups are created or replaced by name

schema.description: The YAML subset documented in ruler/README.md: no anchors, aliases, merge keys or tags.

post.summary: If this rule had existed: the intervals it would have been pending and firing, and the counts, from one computation

get.summary: The notifier config (Alertmanager shape) with every secret redacted

put.summary: Replace the notifier config. A webhook `secret` is write-only: omitted, the stored one is kept; empty, it is removed

schema.description: Alertmanager's route / receivers / inhibit_rules, plus delivery

post.summary: Undo a silence call while its undo window is open: the silences are removed as if never made

get.summary: One monitor with its history: state transitions and notifications, who, what and when

put.summary: Update a monitor; its id and history are kept

409.description: The rule has no monitor metadata

delete.summary: Delete a monitor; its firing alerts are resolved and its history is dropped

post.summary: Acknowledge the monitor's firing alerts: records who and when, stops repeat notifications until each alert resolves, hides nothing
Take the acknowledgement back; repeat notifications resume
Silence the monitor's firing alerts for a duration: one Alertmanager-style silence per alert, matching exactly its labels. Returns an undo token, once

apiKey.description: A viz API key (`viz_<keyId>_<secret>`), as Bearer or as the password of Basic. Scopes: monitors:read, monitors:write, monitors:ack. The key decides the tenant.

dryRun.name: dryRun
dryRun.description: Validate and report what would happen; change nothing.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, disabled or wrong API key

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the scope this operation needs

NotFound.description: No such resource for this tenant

path.description: The field, e.g. `condition.threshold` or `groups[0].rules[2].for`; `line 12` for a YAML error

threshold.description: In the unit the query returns: a ratio of 1% is 0.01

group.description: Default: monitors/<interval>, shared by monitors with the same interval

notify.description: A receiver name from the notifier config

noData.description: When the query returns nothing: resolve (ok), fire after noDataFor (alerting), or keep the last state (keep)

TimelineEntry.description: `source: ruler` entries are state transitions; `source: notifier` entries are notifications and what people did.

dropped.description: Entries dropped because the log is bounded; 0 means the history is complete

fingerprint.description: One alert; default: every firing alert of the monitor

Rule.description: A Prometheus rule: `alert` or `record`. viz adds no_data, no_data_for, no_data_expr and monitor to alerting rules.

BacktestRequest.description: Give `monitor` (the document you are about to save) or `rule` (an alerting rule).

open.description: Still in this state at the end of the range

note.description: What this step can and cannot show
